lines.en: I slide flat along the sandy bottom.
Both fins beat together.

lines.zh: 我的身子几乎贴着海底。
lines.en: My body lies almost on the seabed.
I tilt up a little.
I drift over the seagrass.
Both my eyes are on one side.
I wobble, then settle.
I follow the rises in the sand.
I angle away from the stone.
I glide slowly, without effort.
I raise a small cloud of sand.
I slide toward deeper water.
I bank sideways into a turn.
I move with the current.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚的影子里过去。
lines.en: I pass through the coral's shadow.
I reach the edge of the weeds and stop.
I circle close to the rock.
My tail gives one light beat.

lines.zh: 沙盖住了我的半个身子。
lines.en: Sand covers half of me.
I wait for something small to pass.
The water is cool and clear.
One of my eyes turns.

lines.zh: 我几乎看不出来是活的。
lines.en: I hardly look alive.
Light sifts down from the surface.
I release a small bubble.
I fold my fins slowly.
The sand ripples keep changing.
I lie buried, waiting for the sand to stir.
A crab walks past.
My colour matches the sand.
I feel the water shift once.
I lie in the sand at your feet.
Your bubbles are rising.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，两只眼都朝上。
lines.en: I look up, both eyes turned.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了一片沙。
lines.en: Your shadow covers a patch of sand.
I have lived in this stretch a long time.
That net is meant for me, isn't it.
I can see that net in your hand.
When the water clouds, I cannot see you.
Something jabbed me and I darted off.
I lie flat and still.
Your step left me dazed.
I work my fins to steady.
That turned me over.
I right myself and bury in again.
Don't step on me — I'm lying perfectly flat.

lines.zh: 两只眼都看着你呢，别踢。
lines.en: Both my eyes are on you — no kicking.
I can smell it.
I lift one eye slowly.
Just press it into the sand.
I am not fussy; small worms best.
I have slid over.
It is still struggling.
Don't shake; the water moves.
There is more in the sand; I can smell it.
You stepped into the sand and touched me.
I shoot two blocks away.
The sand clouds and I cannot see.
I am too flat to hurt you.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，我滑开了。
lines.en: We touched and I slid away.

lines.zh: 你的靴子正好压在我旁边。
lines.en: Your boot pressed down right beside me.

lines.zh: 我整片贴在海底，你踢起了沙。
lines.en: Flat on the seabed, and you kick up sand.
The bump set me crooked.
I settle back onto the bottom.
Do not move again.
I am only a flounder.
The water must warm first.
I am the only one on this sandy bottom.
I bury myself and pretend not to hear.
I flick my tail and swim off.
We do not speak of that in the water.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛都在一边，看不见你。
lines.en: My eyes are both on one side; I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 这个问题让我沉进沙里。
lines.en: That question sinks me into the sand.
Wait for the tide to turn.

lines.zh: 它掉在沙上，就在我嘴边。
lines.en: It fell on the sand, right by my mouth.
I pushed twice and it would not move.
Too hard; I spat it out.

lines.zh: 沙盖住了它，我又挖出来。
lines.en: Sand covered it and I dug it out.
I held it a while.
This is too dry to be food.

lines.zh: 我用扁平的嘴把它叼走。
lines.en: I grip it in my flat mouth and carry it off.

lines.zh: 这口吃的，我埋沙里慢慢吃。
lines.en: I'll bury this bite in the sand and eat it slowly.
The water moved.
I raise one eye.
The gravel stirs and I lift an eye.
A shadow sways on the bottom.
I lift slightly out of the sand.
That thing is far bigger than a worm.
I turn toward it.
I creep along the sand.

lines.zh: 它踩着沙，没看见底下的我。
lines.en: It treads the sand and does not see me.
I flatten my fins, ready.
I slide after its shadow.
I press lower.
It paused by the rock.
I turn on my side and slide in.
The sand hides me.
It turns and I sink.
I read the water's movement.
My fins are taut.
I burst up out of the sand and ram it.

lines.zh: 这一下没力气，只是撞了撞。
lines.en: There was no force; just a bump.
It kicks up a cloud of sand.
I bite; my teeth are small.
It backs off and I slide behind the stone.
I flick my tail at its foot.
It stomps and I dive into the sand.
It cannot do much about me.
I settle back to the bottom, quiet.
I settle onto a sandy bottom.
This stretch is ordinary ocean.
I bury myself straight away.
The water is clear, the light bright.

lines.zh: 我先看看四周有没有礁。
lines.en: First I check for reef around me.
I turn on my side and settle.
A school of fish passes overhead.
The sand here is soft.
I fan the sand twice.
Good; wait for something to come.
The water heats and I cannot bear it.
I fall from the surface onto the sand.
Out of water I cannot last.
A harpoon drives into the sand beside me.

lines.zh: 那股力量从水里穿过来。
lines.en: That force comes through the water.

lines.zh: 沙底什么都没有，我饿了。
lines.en: Nothing on the bottom; I am hungry.
The water is gone; my fins beat at nothing.
